title: English Practice Quiz 0922
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: An agenda is prepared to ___.
questions.explanation: outline topics for discussion is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Meeting minutes usually record ___.
questions.explanation: decisions and action items is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A quorum is the minimum attendance needed to ___.
questions.explanation: conduct official business is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: If discussion leaves the agenda, the chair should ___.
options: guide it back to the topic
questions.explanation: guide it back to the topic is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: An action item should include an owner and ___.
questions.explanation: a due date is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A short-notice meeting is arranged ___.
questions.explanation: with little advance warning is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: If unable to attend, a participant should ___.
questions.explanation: inform the organiser is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A useful meeting summary focuses on ___.
questions.explanation: decisions, responsibilities and next steps is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A recurring meeting takes place ___.
questions.explanation: repeatedly on a schedule is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: If a meeting lacks an objective, the organiser should ___.
options: define its purpose and expected outcome
questions.explanation: define its purpose and expected outcome is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.
